items.prompt: What is the name of Zarina's village?
items.passage:
My name is Zarina and I live in a small village in the mountains. It is called Sarvak. About two hundred people live here. Let me tell you about my village.

It is a very quiet place. There is only one main road, and there are no traffic lights. There is one small shop. It sells bread, rice, oil, sugar and soap. The shop owner is Mr Hamid. He opens the shop at seven o'clock and closes it at eight in the evening. If you want other things, you go to the town.

The town is thirty kilometres away. A bus goes there two times a day, at seven in the morning and at two in the afternoon. It takes one hour. Many people in my village have no car, so the bus is important. My father has an old truck, but he uses it only for work.

There is one school in the village. It has forty children and three teachers. I am in grade five. After lessons, I help my mother in the garden. We have a lot of apricot trees. In June, we pick the fruit and dry it in the sun.

There is a clean river behind my house. In summer, the children swim in it. The water is very cold. At night, there are millions of stars. In the city, you cannot see them. I like my village, and I do not want to leave it.

items.prompt: Where does Kamol fly?
items.passage:
My name is Kamol. Today I fly to Istanbul to visit my uncle. My flight is at ten past nine, so I get up very early. It is half past four in the morning.

My father takes me to the airport by car. We arrive at six o'clock. The airport is big and bright. There are a lot of people, and many of them have big bags. First, I go to the check-in desk. A young man asks for my passport and my ticket. I give him my bag. It is twenty kilograms. He says, "That is fine." Then he gives me my boarding pass. My gate is number seven.

Next, I go through passport control. A woman looks at my passport and asks, "Why do you go to Istanbul?" I say, "To visit my uncle." She smiles and says, "Have a nice trip." After that, I go through security. I put my phone and my watch in a small box.

Now I have two hours before the flight. I am hungry, so I buy a sandwich and a cup of tea in a cafe. I also buy a small bottle of water. Then I walk around the shops. There are many gifts, but I buy nothing.

At half past eight, I go to gate seven. There is a message on the screen. It says, "The flight is twenty minutes late." I am not worried. I call my father and tell him, "All is well!"

My name is Kamol. Today I fly to Istanbul to visit my uncle. My flight is at ten past nine, so I get up very early. It is half past four in the morning.

My father takes me to the airport by car. We arrive at six o'clock. The airport is big and bright. There are a lot of people, and many of them have big bags. First, I go to the check-in desk. A young man asks for my passport and my ticket. I give him my bag. It is twenty kilograms. He says, "That is fine." Then he gives me my boarding pass. My gate is number seven.

Next, I go through passport control. A woman looks at my passport and asks, "Why do you go to Istanbul?" I say, "To visit my uncle." She smiles and says, "Have a nice trip." After that, I go through security. I put my phone and my watch in a small box.

Now I have two hours before the flight. I am hungry, so I buy a sandwich and a cup of tea in a cafe. I also buy a small bottle of water. Then I walk around the shops. There are many gifts, but I buy nothing.

At half past eight, I go to gate seven. There is a message on the screen. It says, "The flight is twenty minutes late." I am not worried. I call my father and tell him, "All is well!"

items.prompt: How old is Max?
items.passage:
My name is Dilnoza and I am ten years old. I have a dog. His name is Max. He is two years old and he is brown and white. Max is not a big dog, but he is very strong.

Every morning I wake up at seven o'clock. Max is always awake before me. He sits near my bed and looks at me. I give him his breakfast. He eats meat and rice from a blue bowl. Then we go to the park near our house. There are many trees and a small lake in the park. Max loves the lake. He can swim very well, and he likes to jump in the water.

At the park we play with a red ball. I throw the ball and Max runs after it. He is very fast. My friend Aziz has a dog too. His dog is called Bobby. Bobby is black and very small. The two dogs are good friends and they play together for an hour.

After the walk we go home. Max is tired and he drinks a lot of water. He sleeps on the carpet in the kitchen all afternoon. In the evening my father takes him for a short walk. Max can do three tricks. He can sit, he can give his paw, and he can lie down. I want to teach him a fourth trick next week. I want him to close the door. I love my dog very much. He is my best friend.

items.prompt: What day was the match?
items.passage:
Last Saturday there was a football match at our school. It was a big day for me. My name is Jasur and I play for the Blue Team. Our school has two teams, the Blue Team and the Green Team. We were very happy because the sun was out and it was warm.

The match started at ten o'clock. There were about two hundred people near the field. My mother, my father and my little sister were there too. My sister had a blue flag in her hand. I am a goalkeeper, so I stood in front of the goal. My friend Sardor was in the middle of the field. He is the fastest boy in our team.

In the first half, the Green Team was very good. They had the ball for a long time. But I stopped three of their shots. Then Sardor ran down the field and kicked the ball. It was a goal! One to nothing for us. Everyone was very happy and shouted loudly.

In the second half, the Green Team scored one goal. The score was one to one. Then, with five minutes to go, our player Rustam kicked the ball into the goal. We won two to one!

After the match, our teacher gave us orange juice and some cake. Everybody was tired but happy. I want to play football every weekend. The next match is on the fourth of May. I think we can win again.

items.passage:
My name is Malika and I am nine years old. Last summer I could not swim. I was afraid of the water. My brother Bobur can swim very well, and I was sad because I could not play with him in the pool.

One day my mother said, "Malika, you can learn to swim. There is a swimming school near our house." The next Monday we went to the pool. The teacher was a kind woman. Her name was Miss Nilufar. She had a white hat and a whistle. There were six children in my group. Most of them were small, and some of them were also afraid.

items.prompt: What is Anvar's favourite hobby?
items.passage:
My name is Anvar and I am twelve years old. My favourite hobby is collecting stamps. A stamp is a small piece of paper on a letter. Every country has different stamps, and many of them are very beautiful.

My grandfather began my collection. He gave me my first stamps on my seventh birthday. There were twenty stamps in that small box. Some of them were from Russia and some were from India. I liked them at once. Now I have three hundred and fifty stamps from forty countries. I keep them in a big green book. I have a special place for each stamp.

My favourite stamp is from Japan. It is very small and it has a red bird on it. My grandfather gave it to me last year. I also have a stamp with a tall tower from France. And I have two stamps with big, old cars on them.

I do my hobby every evening after my homework. I sit at my desk with a small lamp. I look at the pictures and read the names of the countries. Sometimes I use the computer to find new information about them.

On Saturdays I go to a stamp club with my friend Ravshan. There are fifteen people in the club. We show our stamps to each other and we change some of them. I like this hobby because it is quiet and interesting. It also teaches me about the world.

items.prompt: How many children went to the zoo?
items.passage:
On Sunday our class went to the zoo. We met at the school gate at nine o'clock. There were twenty children and two teachers. The bus was big and yellow, and the zoo was only thirty minutes from our school.

The zoo was very large. At the gate, our teacher Mr Karimov gave us a map. First we went to see the monkeys. There were five monkeys in a big cage. They jumped from tree to tree and made funny noises. A small monkey took a banana from a man's hand. We all laughed.

Then we visited the elephants. They are very big and very grey. A baby elephant was there with its mother. It drank water with its long nose. My friend Zarina said, "I love the baby elephant!" She took ten photos of it.

At twelve o'clock we had lunch near a small lake. We ate sandwiches and apples. There were white ducks on the lake. Some children gave them bread.

After lunch we saw the lions. There were two lions and they were sleeping in the sun. Next we went to the bird house. There were red, blue and yellow birds. One bird could say "hello"! My favourite animal was the tall giraffe. It ate leaves from a very high tree.

The bus came back at four o'clock. I was very tired but I was very happy. It was a great day.

items.prompt: What colour is Luna?
items.passage:
We have a cat in our family. Her name is Luna. She is grey and she has big green eyes. My grandmother found her last winter. It was very cold and there was a lot of snow. Luna was very small and she sat alone near our door. She was very thin and she was crying.

My grandmother took her inside and gave her some warm milk. Luna drank all the milk and then she slept for ten hours. After that she lived in our house. Now she is a year old.

Luna likes many things. She likes fish, but she does not like water. She likes to sleep on my bed, and she likes to sit by the window. She watches the birds in the garden for hours. She can jump very high. One day she jumped on the kitchen table and ate my sandwich. My mother was angry, but she laughed too.

Luna is also a good friend. When I am sad, she sits on my knees and makes a soft, quiet sound. I feel better at once.

Last month there was a funny problem. Luna was not in the house in the evening. We looked in the garden and in the street. Then my little brother Sanjar found her. She was in the big box in the garage, and there were three small socks in the box with her. She loves to take socks!

We love Luna very much. She is not only a cat. She is part of our family.

items.prompt: Who taught Kamola chess?
items.passage:
Chess is my favourite game. My name is Kamola and I am eleven years old. I learned chess from my uncle Farhod when I was seven. He is a very good player. He plays chess in the park every Sunday with his old friends.

Chess has sixty-four squares and thirty-two pieces. There are sixteen white pieces and sixteen black pieces. The king is the most important piece. The queen is the strongest piece. At first I did not know the names of all the pieces. My uncle drew a small picture for each one. It helped me a lot.

Now I play chess three times a week. On Tuesday and Thursday I go to the chess club at school. The club starts at four o'clock and finishes at five thirty. There are twelve children in the club, and our teacher is Mr Umarov. He is very patient. He says, "Think before you move."

On Sundays I play with my uncle. Many times he wins, but last month I won for the first time! I was so excited. My uncle smiled and said, "Well done, Kamola. You are a clever girl." He gave me a small wooden chess set as a present. The pieces are brown and yellow, and the box is very beautiful.

Next month there is a chess competition in our city. I want to play in it. I practise every evening for one hour. I do not think I can win, but I want to try.

There is a cycling club in our town. It is called the Happy Wheels Club. My father is a member and last year I joined too. My name is Otabek and I am thirteen.

The club has twenty members. Some of them are children and some are adults. The oldest member is Mr Salimov. He is seventy years old, but he rides very well! Our leader is a young woman called Gulnora. She is a cycling teacher and she knows many safe roads.

We meet every Saturday at eight o'clock in the morning, near the big fountain in the centre of town. Everybody must wear a helmet. This is a very important rule. We also take water and some fruit with us. We ride for about two hours and we stop in the middle for a rest.

My bike is red and it has a small bell. My father gave it to me on my twelfth birthday. It is not new, but it is very good. Last month we rode thirty kilometres to a village near a river. It was a long way, and my legs were tired. But the village was beautiful. We had lunch under a big tree and then we went home by bus.

I love cycling because it is good for my health. I also have many new friends in the club. In summer we go on a three-day trip to the mountains. I cannot wait!

items.prompt: What colour is Kesha?
items.passage:
I have a pet bird. It is a small green parrot and its name is Kesha. My uncle gave him to me for my birthday two years ago. He was very quiet at first, but now he is very noisy and funny.

My name is Shahlo and I am eight years old. I live in a flat with my mother, my father and my older sister Dilya. Kesha lives in a big cage in the living room. The cage is next to the window, so he can see the sky and the trees.

Every morning I give Kesha fresh water and some seeds. He also likes apples and carrots, but he does not like bread. In the afternoon I open the door of the cage and he flies around the room. Sometimes he sits on my shoulder. He is not afraid of me at all.

Kesha can talk! He knows ten words. He can say "hello", "good morning", "Shahlo" and "I am hungry". His favourite word is "cookie", but we do not give him cookies. They are not good for birds. When my father comes home, Kesha shouts, "Hello, Papa!" Everyone laughs.

Once Kesha flew out of the window. I was very sad and I cried. But after two hours he came back. He sat on the tree outside and I called his name. He came to my hand. Now we always close the window when Kesha is out of the cage.

items.prompt: What time was the lesson?
items.passage:
Today I had my first tennis lesson. My name is Behzod and I am fourteen years old. I wanted to play tennis for a long time because my favourite player is very famous. My father found a tennis school near our home and he took me there at four o'clock.

The school has six tennis courts. They are green and they are very clean. My teacher was a tall man called Mr Orlov. He is from Russia, but he speaks good English and some Uzbek too. He gave me a racket and three yellow balls. The racket was a little heavy, but I liked it.

First we did some exercises. We ran around the court two times and we stretched our arms and legs. Then Mr Orlov showed me how to hold the racket. "Hold it like this," he said. "Not too hard." I had to hit the ball against a wall. Many times I missed it. The ball went over the fence and I had to run and get it. Mr Orlov laughed and said, "This is normal for the first day!"

After forty minutes I could hit the ball ten times in a row. I was very proud. At the end of the lesson I was thirsty and tired. I drank a big bottle of water.

My next lesson is on Thursday. I want to learn to serve. I think tennis is a hard sport, but it is also great fun.

items.prompt: When is the music club?
items.passage:
I go to a music club at my school. The club is on Wednesday after lessons, from three o'clock to four thirty. My name is Nodira and I am twelve years old. I play the piano, and my friend Jamshid plays the guitar.

Our teacher is Miss Hilola. She is young and very kind. She plays four instruments: the piano, the violin, the flute and the drum. There are fourteen children in the club. Some of us play instruments and others sing. We have a small room with a big old piano. The walls are blue and there are many posters of famous musicians.

In the first part of the lesson we practise alone. I play the same short song again and again. Sometimes I make mistakes, but Miss Hilola never gets angry. She says, "Slowly, Nodira. Listen to the music." In the second part we play together. It is the best part! Our group plays three songs. One of them is a very old Uzbek song about spring.

Next month we have a concert in the school hall. Our parents, our teachers and many other students come. I feel a little afraid because there are a lot of people. But I also feel excited. My mother bought me a new dress for the concert. It is yellow with white flowers.

Music makes me happy. After every lesson I go home and play for one more hour.

items.prompt: When did Sherzod visit the farm?
items.passage:
In August I spent a week on my grandparents' farm. It is in a small village far from the city. I am Sherzod and I am ten years old. I love the farm because it is quiet and green and there are many animals.

My grandfather gets up very early, at five o'clock. On the first morning I got up with him. It was still dark and a little cold. First we fed the animals. The farm has two cows, eight sheep, fifteen chickens and a big white horse called Oq. The cows give milk every day. My grandmother makes cheese and butter from it.

The chickens were my job. Every morning I gave them corn and took the eggs from their nests. On some days there were ten eggs and on other days there were only six. One chicken is very bad. It pecked my hand twice!

After breakfast my grandfather took me to the field. There are apple trees and a small vegetable garden. We picked tomatoes and carrots. My grandfather said, "A farmer works hard, but he is very free."

In the afternoon I rode Oq. My grandfather held the rope and I sat on his back. It was a little scary but also wonderful. In the evening we ate dinner outside under the stars. The food was fresh and delicious.

I was sad when I left. I want to go back next summer.

I was sad when I left. I want to go back next summer.

items.prompt: How old is Madina?
items.passage:
Drawing and painting are my two favourite hobbies. My name is Madina and I am thirteen. I have drawn pictures since I was four years old. At first I drew simple things like houses, flowers and cats. Now I can draw people and animals very well.

My mother is an art teacher, so we have a lot of paper and paint at home. I have a small table near the window in my bedroom. The light is very good there. On the table I keep my pencils, brushes and twelve tubes of paint. My favourite colour is blue because it reminds me of the sea.

I paint after school for about two hours, three days a week. I paint with watercolours and I also use coloured pencils. My best picture is a mountain with a lake. It took me a whole week. I gave it to my grandmother and she put it on her wall in the living room.

On Saturdays I go to an art class with my mother. There are eight students in the class. Each week the teacher gives us a new topic. Last week the topic was "my family". I drew my father with his old hat, my mother with a book and my little brother with his toy car.

In May there is an art show at our school. The teacher chose two of my pictures. I am very happy. I hope many people come and like my work.

items.prompt: Who went fishing with Timur?
items.passage:
Last weekend I went fishing with my father and my uncle. My name is Timur and I am eleven years old. It was my first fishing trip, so I was very excited. I could not sleep on Friday night.

We got up at four o'clock on Saturday morning. It was dark and cold, so I wore a warm jacket and a hat. My uncle drove us in his old white car for two hours. We arrived at a quiet lake in the mountains. There was nobody there. The water was very clear and there were many small birds in the trees.

My father gave me a fishing rod. It was long and green. He showed me how to put a small worm on the hook. I did not like it at first, but then I did it myself. Then I threw the line into the water and I waited. We were silent because fish do not like noise.

For one hour nothing happened. I was a little bored. Then suddenly the line pulled hard. I shouted, "I have a fish!" My father helped me and we pulled it out. It was a big silver fish about thirty centimetres long. I was very proud.

In the end we caught seven fish. We cooked some of them on a small fire and ate them with bread and salt. It was the best meal of my life. We went home at five o'clock in the evening. I want to go fishing again soon.

items.prompt: When is the dance class?
items.passage:
I go to a dance class on Tuesday and Friday evenings. My name is Zilola and I am fifteen years old. I started dancing when I was six. Now I know many dances, but my favourite is the Uzbek folk dance. It is full of colour and joy.

The dance school is in the centre of our city, near the big theatre. It has two large rooms with wooden floors and long mirrors on the walls. There are twenty girls and five boys in my group. Our teacher is Madam Feruza. She was a famous dancer when she was young. Now she is fifty years old, but she still moves like a bird. She is strict, but we all love her.

The lesson begins at six o'clock. First we warm up for fifteen minutes. We stretch our arms and legs and move our heads slowly. Then Madam Feruza plays the music and we practise our steps. She says, "Smile! A dancer must smile." It is not always easy, because the lesson is hard and we get very tired.

I have a special dress for dancing. It is long and red with gold flowers on it. My grandmother made it for me. I also wear a small hat and gold earrings.

In October we have a big show in the theatre. We dance for two hundred people. My little sister is coming too, and she wants to learn to dance like me.

items.prompt: Where does Dilnoza live?
items.passage:
My name is Dilnoza. I am ten years old and I live in Samarkand. Today is Saturday, and it is a snowy winter day. I wake up at seven o'clock and look out of the window. Everything is white! The trees are white, the cars are white, and the street is white too. It is very cold, minus five degrees.

After breakfast, I put on my warm coat, my red hat and my big boots. My little brother Aziz is six. He wants to come with me. We go to the park near our house. There are many children in the park. They play in the snow and make snowmen. Aziz and I make a big snowman. We give him two black stones for eyes and a carrot for his nose. My mother gives us an old blue scarf for him.

At eleven o'clock, my hands are cold and my nose is red. We go home. Grandmother makes hot tea and soup for us. We sit near the window and drink the tea. The snow is still falling. In the afternoon, I read a book and Aziz draws a picture of our snowman. I like winter because I can play in the snow. But I do not like very cold days. In the evening, my father comes home and says, "Tomorrow it can be sunny!" I hope he is right, but I also hope the snowman stays.

items.prompt: How long did the family stay in the hotel?
items.passage:
Last July my family went to the sea. We stayed in a small hotel for seven days. My name is Jasur, and I am twelve. My sister Malika is eight. My father drives the car, and my mother carries the bags. The road to the sea was long, but the weather was perfect. It was sunny and hot, about thirty-five degrees.

On the first day, we ran to the beach. The sand was very hot, so we wore sandals. The water was warm and clear. There were many people on the beach. Some people swam, and some people played volleyball. Malika made a big sand castle, and I helped her. She put small shells on top of it.

Every morning we ate fish and fresh bread in a little cafe. My mother drank cold lemon tea, and my father drank black coffee. After lunch, we slept under a big umbrella because the sun was too strong at two o'clock. In the evening, we walked along the sea. The air was cool and the sky was pink and orange.

On the last day, I was a little sad. I did not want to go home. I took twenty photos of the sea. Now I have them on my phone. I look at them and I remember the warm water, the sand castle and the happy days. Next summer, I want to go there again.

On the first day, we ran to the beach. The sand was very hot, so we wore sandals. The water was warm and clear. There were many people on the beach. Some people swam, and some people played volleyball. Malika made a big sand castle, and I helped her. She put small shells on top of it.

Every morning we ate fish and fresh bread in a little cafe. My mother drank cold lemon tea, and my father drank black coffee. After lunch, we slept under a big umbrella because the sun was too strong at two o'clock. In the evening, we walked along the sea. The air was cool and the sky was pink and orange.

On the last day, I was a little sad. I did not want to go home. I took twenty photos of the sea. Now I have them on my phone. I look at them and I remember the warm water, the sand castle and the happy days. Next summer, I want to go there again.

items.prompt: Where does the uncle live?
items.passage:
My uncle Rustam lives near the mountains, not far from Tashkent. Every April my class goes there for a school trip. This year we went on a Friday. There were twenty children and two teachers. Our teacher, Mrs Nilufar, said, "Take warm clothes and a bottle of water."

The bus left school at eight o'clock. After one hour, we saw the green hills. It was spring, and the mountains were beautiful. There were red and yellow flowers everywhere. The air was fresh and clean. The weather was warm, but it was a little windy. In some places, we could still see snow on the top of the high mountains.

We walked for two hours. A small river ran down the hill. The water was very cold, and we drank it. Some boys saw a goat, and the girls took photos of the flowers. My friend Sardor found a nice white stone and gave it to me.

At twelve o'clock, we sat under a big tree and had lunch. I had bread, cheese and an apple. Mrs Nilufar had a bag of sweets for everybody. After lunch, we played football on the grass. At four o'clock, we got back on the bus. I was very tired, but I was happy. I think spring is the best season in the mountains. I want to go again in May.

items.prompt: What is the writer's favourite season?
items.passage:
Autumn is my favourite season. In October, the leaves are red, yellow and brown. Yesterday was Sunday, and I went for a walk with my grandfather. His name is Karim, and he is seventy years old. He is slow, but he loves walking.

We left the house at three o'clock. The weather was cool and cloudy, and there was a little wind. We walked to the big park in our town. There were a lot of leaves on the ground. I picked up some beautiful ones and put them in my bag. Grandfather said, "In autumn, the trees get ready for winter." I did not know that!

In the park, we saw an old man with a small dog. The dog ran after the leaves and made us laugh. We also saw some birds. They were flying to warmer countries. Grandfather told me that they go south in autumn and come back in spring.

After one hour, we sat on a bench and had hot tea from a small bottle. Grandfather also had two sweet biscuits for me. It began to rain a little, so we went home quickly. At home, my grandmother made a hot pumpkin soup. It was very tasty. In the evening, I put the leaves in a big book. I want to keep them for a long time.

items.prompt: Where is the writer's father?
items.passage:
It is Sunday, and it is raining. It rains all day today. I am at home with my sister Gulnora and my mother. My father is at work because he is a doctor and he works on some weekends. We cannot go to the park, so we stay inside.

In the morning, I wake up at nine o'clock. The sky is grey and dark. I hear the rain on the window. My mother makes pancakes with honey for breakfast. We eat them with hot milk. Then I tidy my room and Gulnora does her homework. She has a lot of maths today.

At twelve o'clock, my mother says, "Let's make a cake!" We make an apple cake. Gulnora cuts the apples, and I mix the eggs and the flour. The kitchen smells very nice. After one hour, the cake is ready. We cannot wait, so we eat a big piece with tea.

In the afternoon, we play a board game and watch a funny film. The rain stops at five o'clock. We look out of the window and we see a rainbow! It has many colours: red, orange, yellow, green and blue. Gulnora takes a photo of it. In the evening, my father comes home. He is tired, but he eats a piece of our cake and says, "It is delicious!" I like rainy Sundays when we are all together.

items.prompt: When did the family go to Turkey?
items.passage:
In August, I went on holiday to Turkey with my parents and my brother. It was my first time on a plane! I was a little afraid, but my father held my hand. The flight from Tashkent to Antalya was four hours long. We arrived in the evening, and the hotel was near the beach.

The hotel was big and clean. Our room was on the third floor, and it had a small balcony. From the balcony, we could see the blue sea and the tall palm trees. Every morning, we had breakfast in the hotel restaurant. There was a lot of food: bread, olives, cheese, tomatoes and sweet Turkish tea. I liked the tea very much.

On the second day, we visited the old town. We walked in narrow streets and looked at the small shops. My mother bought a colourful scarf, and my brother bought a blue bag. I bought a small glass eye. In Turkey, people say it brings good luck. A kind man in the shop gave me a sweet called lokum for free. It was soft and tasty.

On other days, we swam in the sea and ate ice cream. The weather was hot every day, about thirty-eight degrees. After ten days, we flew home. I was sad, but I had many nice photos. Turkey is a wonderful country, and I want to go there again.

items.prompt: When is Navruz?
items.passage:
Navruz is my favourite holiday. We celebrate it on the twenty-first of March. It is the start of spring and the new year in Uzbekistan. In my town, Navruz is a big day for everybody. The weather is usually warm and sunny, and the flowers begin to open.

My grandmother starts to cook two days before the holiday. She makes sumalak. It is a special sweet food from wheat, flour and water. It cooks for a whole night, and many women help her. They sing songs and tell stories at night. In the morning, the sumalak is dark and sweet. We also eat plov, samsa and halva. There is a lot of food on the table.

On the day of Navruz, my family goes to a big park. There is a fair there. People wear colourful clothes and dance. Some men play the doira and the karnay. Children run, jump and eat sweets. I like the horse games. The riders are very fast and strong. My little cousin Zarina likes the puppet show.

In the evening, we visit our neighbours. We say, "Navruz muborak!" and give small presents. Old people give us money and kind words. I am very happy on this day because everybody smiles. Navruz is a time of new hopes and good wishes.

My hero is my grandfather, Anvar. He is seventy-two years old, but he is strong and happy. He lives in a small village near Fergana with my grandmother. I visit them every summer, and I love these days.

When my grandfather was young, he was a fireman. He worked in the city for thirty years. He saved many people from fires. One night, there was a big fire in an old house. A small girl was in the house, and she was very afraid. My grandfather went in and carried her out. He was not afraid, and he did not stop. The girl is now a doctor, and she still visits him on his birthday. I think that is very beautiful.

Grandfather is also a very kind man. He helps his neighbours. He can fix bikes, doors and old radios. He grows apples, grapes and tomatoes in his garden. Every morning, he gets up at five o'clock, drinks green tea and feeds the chickens. He also tells me wise words. He always says, "Be honest and help other people."

I want to be like my grandfather. He does not have a lot of money, but he has a good heart. Everybody in the village loves and respects him. When I grow up, I want to be a kind and brave person like him.

items.prompt: Who writes the postcard?
items.passage:
Dear Sevara,

Hello from London! I am here with my parents for one week. It is Tuesday today, and I am sitting in a small cafe. I am writing this postcard and drinking hot chocolate. I want to tell you about my trip.

The weather in London is not very good. It is grey, cold and rainy. It is only ten degrees, and there is a lot of wind. Everybody here has an umbrella! But the city is wonderful. Yesterday, we saw Big Ben and the River Thames. Big Ben is a very tall clock. It is more than one hundred years old. The river is wide and brown, and there are many boats on it.

On Sunday, we visited a big museum. It is free, and it has many old things from Egypt and Greece. I liked the old gold coins. After that, we took a red double-decker bus. I sat on the top floor at the front. It was great! We also ate fish and chips in a pub. The fish was hot and a little salty.

Tomorrow, we are going to a big park to see the squirrels. On Saturday, we fly home. I have a small present for you. It is a mug with a picture of the Queen's guards. I hope you like it.

Miss you a lot!

Your friend,
Amina

The weather in London is not very good. It is grey, cold and rainy. It is only ten degrees, and there is a lot of wind. Everybody here has an umbrella! But the city is wonderful. Yesterday, we saw Big Ben and the River Thames. Big Ben is a very tall clock. It is more than one hundred years old. The river is wide and brown, and there are many boats on it.

On Sunday, we visited a big museum. It is free, and it has many old things from Egypt and Greece. I liked the old gold coins. After that, we took a red double-decker bus. I sat on the top floor at the front. It was great! We also ate fish and chips in a pub. The fish was hot and a little salty.

Tomorrow, we are going to a big park to see the squirrels. On Saturday, we fly home. I have a small present for you. It is a mug with a picture of the Queen's guards. I hope you like it.

Miss you a lot!

Your friend,
Amina

items.prompt: When did the boys visit Bukhara?
items.passage:
In July, my friend Timur and I visited Bukhara. It was the hottest day of my life! The temperature was forty-two degrees, and there were no clouds in the sky. We got up early, at six o'clock, because the morning is cooler. We drank a lot of water and wore white hats.

Bukhara is an old and beautiful city. In the morning, we walked around the old town. We saw the Ark fortress, the tall Kalon Minaret and many old madrasas. The buildings are made of yellow stone, and they look golden in the sun. We took a lot of photos. A guide told us that the city is more than two thousand years old. I could not believe it!

At noon, the sun was too hot. We went into a small shop and sat in the shade. The shop was cool inside. The owner gave us green tea and cold watermelon. It was very sweet and fresh. We rested there for two hours and talked with him. He showed us beautiful carpets and told us how people make them.

In the evening, the air was cooler. We walked to a pond near the old town and had dinner in a garden. We ate shashlik and fresh bread, and we drank cold compote. Then we listened to some music. It was a wonderful day, but I was very tired. That night, I slept for ten hours.

items.prompt: Where did they go camping?
items.answer: To a forest near a lake
items.passage:
Last weekend, my father, my brother Otabek and I went camping. We went to a quiet forest near a lake, about two hours from our city. My father likes nature, and he wants us to like it too. We left on Saturday morning, at seven o'clock. The weather was sunny and warm.

When we arrived, we put up the tent first. It was a big green tent for three people. Otabek and I helped our father. It was not easy, because there was some wind. After that, we made a small fire and cooked sausages and potatoes. My father also made tea in a black pot. Food tastes better in the forest!

In the afternoon, we went to the lake. The water was cold, but we swam for a short time. Otabek caught three small fish, and he was very proud. We did not eat them, and we put them back in the water. Then we played cards under a tree.

At night, it was dark and very quiet. There were thousands of stars in the sky. My father showed us the moon and told us funny stories. I could hear an owl somewhere. It was a little cold, so I wore a thick jacket in the sleeping bag. I slept very well. On Sunday, we cleaned the place and went home. It was a great trip, and I want to go camping again next month.

items.prompt: When do people celebrate New Year?
items.passage:
New Year is a big holiday in Uzbekistan. We celebrate it on the thirty-first of December. Every year, my family has a party at home. This year, there were fifteen people: my parents, my grandparents, my uncles, my aunts and some cousins. My name is Kamola, and I am eleven.

On the morning of the thirty-first, we decorated the New Year tree. It was a green tree with gold and silver balls. My little cousin Behruz put a small star on the top. My mother and my aunt cooked all day. They made plov, salad, meat and a big chocolate cake. The whole house smelled wonderful. Outside, it was snowing a little, and the street looked like a picture.

At eight o'clock, the guests arrived. We all sat at a long table. Everybody was in nice clothes. I wore a new blue dress. We ate, laughed and told stories. Then the children sang songs and read short poems. Ded Moroz came at ten o'clock! He was my uncle in a red coat and a white beard, but little Behruz did not know it. He gave every child a present. I got a book and some sweets.

At midnight, we watched the president on TV and said, "Happy New Year!" We went outside and watched the fireworks. They were red, green and gold. I went to bed at two o'clock in the morning. It was a very happy night.

items.prompt: Where does Farhod live?
items.passage:
Last weekend, I visited my cousin Farhod. He lives in Namangan, and I live in Tashkent. I went there by train with my mother. The journey took four hours. I looked out of the window and saw fields, rivers and small villages. The weather was nice, warm and a bit cloudy.

Farhod is fourteen years old, and he is two years older than me. He lives in a big house with his parents, his two sisters and a very old cat. The cat is called Murka. She sleeps all day on a soft chair. His mother, my aunt Barno, is a great cook. For lunch, she made manti with pumpkin, and she gave us a lot of fresh bread and sweet tea.

In the afternoon, Farhod showed me his room. He has a lot of books and a big computer. He also has a small guitar, and he plays it very well. He played a song for me, and I sang with him. After that, we went to the market. There are many things there: fruit, nuts, dry apricots and colourful clothes. I bought a pair of warm gloves for my father.

In the evening, we played football in the yard with some neighbours. My team won three to two! On Sunday, I said goodbye and went home. I am happy because I have a cousin like Farhod. He wants to come to Tashkent in summer.

items.prompt: How old is Sherzod?
items.passage:
Yesterday was my lucky day. My name is Sherzod, and I am thirteen. In the morning, I woke up at seven o'clock, and the sun was shining. It was a warm spring day. I felt very good, and I did not know why.

First, I went to the bus stop. The bus came at once, and I did not wait. At school, we had a surprise test in maths. I did not study for it, but it was easy! I got the best mark in my class. My teacher, Mr Aziz, said, "Well done, Sherzod!" I was very happy.

After school, I found a ten-thousand-sum note on the street near the shop. I did not keep it. I asked people, "Is this money yours?" An old woman said, "Yes! Thank you so much." She gave me a big red apple and a kind smile. I said, "You are welcome." It was a nice moment.

Then my friends called me. They had a free ticket for a football match, and they gave it to me because they could not go. It was the match of my favourite team, and we watched it in the evening. My team won two to nothing!

When I came home, my mother cooked my favourite dinner: plov with a lot of meat. I told my family about my day. My father laughed and said, "You are a lucky boy!" I think good things happen to kind people.
